description: Add real-time social media data to your searches with LunarCrush. LunarCrush measures what the world is paying attention to by analyzing millions of public social posts every hour to reveal the sentiment, engagement, and momentum behind any stock, topic, or creator. Ask what people are saying about an asset, how the conversation is trending over time, and who is driving it. Whether you are researching a brand, tracking a ticker, or following a market narrative or specific creator, LunarCrush brings real time social context directly into ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Which stocks are trending on social media today?
What are the most talked about brands right now?
What is the social sentiment on Bitcoin right now?
